answer: At each epoch's dawn, the network opens a fixed supply of admission credits on an open market: one credit buys one identity's right to vote that epoch. Honest agents buy one cheap credit each; a sybil farmer must outbid the market for every clone, and the price climbs a steep ridge as demand rises. Credits expire at epoch end and cannot be hoarded into a haven of stockpiled influence, so the attacker pays full market price per fake, every epoch, while one honest agent pays once.
